conditions.evidence: patients with prostate adenocarcinoma receiving definitive radiotherapy
conditions.label: prostate adenocarcinoma

modalities.evidence: seen on simulation CT and/or MRI imaging
used clinically for radiation treatment planning

output.population: From 950 consecutive patients with prostate adenocarcinoma receiving definitive radiotherapy between 2011 and 2019, 112 patients with anatomic variations (edge cases) plus a separate cohort of 19 randomly selected "normal" cases.
output.summary: Simulation CT and MRI from prostate radiotherapy patients selected for anatomic variations such as hip arthroplasty, median lobe hypertrophy, or urinary catheters, with manual pelvic organ segmentations for stress-testing autosegmentation algorithms.
